title: Centralize exact Forest/Fourfold node-partition admission across Tensor projection paths

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Implement the bounded GPU-67 decision by extracting the projection verifier's existing exact Forest/Fourfold node-partition logic into one private admission primitive and reusing it from the canonical relation compiler and Boolean compatibility adapter without widening legacy projection semantics.
implementation: projection_verifier now owns private _forest_node_partition admission: duplicate or unmapped Forest nodes, exact per-plane membership, extra Fourfold nodes, and constitutional kind-to-plane placement are checked in one existing authority.
verify_forest_projection reuses the private primitive while retaining deterministic ProjectionFinding reporting instead of creating another verifier surface.
compile_relation_blocks and boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold now reuse the same exact partition admission and remove their duplicated weaker duplicate/missing-only checks.

No relation digest, verified binding, endpoint-completeness, semiring, provenance, or promotion rule was moved into the primitive; retained and unretained relation semantics remain owned by the existing projection paths.
legacy_forest remains intentionally conservative: its narrower kind map and absent Data-plane contract were not changed.
regressions: an extra Fourfold node is reported by verify_forest_projection and refused by both relation compilation paths
a source_file placed in the knowledge plane is reported as missing/extra and refused by both relation compilation paths
legacy fourfold_from_knowledge_forest still refuses data_table rather than silently broadening its Data-plane contract
the existing relation-retention regression owner remains unchanged and continues to pin retained/unretained same-plane semantics

verification.desktop_caveat: Tauri Desktop failed at Rust formatting after cockpit build, frozen-backend build/smoke, project/desktop contract tests, and icon generation succeeded; Rust library tests and Linux bundle were skipped after the formatting failure

bounded_next_step: With node-partition drift removed, inspect the remaining Boolean compatibility adapter duplication against compile_relation_blocks and freeze the smallest semantics-preserving collapse step. Preserve complete-plane refusal, Fourfold-only cross-plane fact authority, retained same-plane relation semantics, and fail-closed hyperedge/undirected behavior; do not introduce a third projector or public abstraction.
